description: The deadlines of the procurement: the published end of proposals and the last day to challenge the tender (estimate: 3 business days before the session, Law 14.133 art. 164, national holidays). Free. Served from the edge cache for up to 6 hours: the record rarely changes. `Cache-Control: no-cache` in the request reads the origin now. The `x-origem-cache` header says `hit`, `miss` or `bypass`.
name: get_deadlines
title: Procurement deadlines
